note: Clubs and committees are taken from the official GNDEC navigation and their own pages. Student chapter names marked verified=false should be confirmed with the college before publishing a formal list.

clubs.name: National Cadet Corps (NCC)
clubs.description: 3 Punjab Battalion NCC cadets train at the sports complex with drill, camps, adventure and SSB preparation.

clubs.name: National Service Scheme (NSS)
clubs.description: Blood donation, cleanliness drives, village outreach and social service camps run through the NSS unit.

clubs.name: Cultural Committee
clubs.description: Music, dance, theatre, fine arts, literary events and the annual Anand Utsav youth festival.

clubs.name: Department of Sports
clubs.description: Cricket, football, basketball, athletics, gym and inter-college tournaments. The department was established in 1956.

clubs.name: ISTE Student Chapter
clubs.description: Indian Society for Technical Education student chapter — workshops, technical talks and paper presentations.

clubs.name: IEEE Student Branch
clubs.description: Student branch for electronics, communication and computing talks, competitions and IEEE events.

clubs.name: CSI Student Chapter
clubs.description: Computer Society of India student chapter — coding events, seminars and industry interaction.

clubs.name: SAE Collegiate Club
clubs.description: Automotive and mobility projects, including formula-style and go-kart build teams.

clubs.name: Robotics & Automation Club
clubs.description: Hands-on robotics, drones, embedded systems and competition teams.

clubs.name: Entrepreneurship Development Cell
clubs.description: Startup awareness, ideathons, pitch events and incubation support through the college innovation ecosystem.

events.name: Anand Utsav
events.description: The college cultural festival with music, dance, drama, fine arts and literary competitions. Auditions are announced on the Cultural Committee site.

events.name: IKGPTU Youth Festival
events.description: GNDEC teams audition for the IKG Punjab Technical University youth festival in singing, dance, theatre, fine arts and literary events.

events.name: Annual Convocation
events.description: Degree award ceremony for graduating batches. Dates and rehearsal instructions are published through notices.

events.name: Annual Sports Meet
events.description: Track and field, team sports and inter-department competitions organised by the Sports Department.

events.name: Department technical festivals
events.description: Departments and student chapters run hackathons, coding contests, project exhibitions and guest lectures. Watch the notice board and department pages.

resources.title: SWAYAM-NPTEL
resources.description: Free certified online courses that can count towards credits under the college's NPTEL policy.

resources.title: Central Library (CML)
resources.description: Books, journals, reference section and reading rooms. Weekdays 8:00 am–10:00 pm, weekends 9:00 am–5:00 pm.

resources.title: Previous-year papers
resources.description: Search 1,600+ papers by subject code and session inside the app.

resources.title: Syllabus library
resources.description: First-year pages and branch-wise syllabus documents.

resources.title: Training & Placement Cell
resources.description: Placement drives, internships and company announcements.
